chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from al-Ṣaffār, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two of them, peace be upon them, who said:

I asked him about a pregnant woman who sees blood just as she used to see during the days of her menstruation, regularly in every month. He said: She refrains from salat just as she used to do during her menstruation, and when she becomes pure, she performs salat.

key_terms.طَهُرَتْ: she became pure from the bleeding
key_terms.مُسْتَقِيمًا: regularly and consistently according to a fixed pattern

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a pregnant woman who sees blood during the time of her usual monthly menstruation?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a pregnant woman who continues to see blood in the same regular pattern as her menstrual days each month. The ruling states that she should refrain from salat during those days as she did in her hayd, and resume salat once she attains taharah.
